**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (preferred level).** No redline proposed.

- **§13.1** grants Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf the subscription access rights (affiliate coverage is unconditional, better than the fallback's written-notice mechanic).
- **§13.2** gives Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence for paid-up software/Vendor Technology and embedded Deliverable material; **§14.3** confirms §13.2 applies to Vendor Technology needed to use a Deliverable.
- **§13.3** prohibits Vendor revocation or suspension except for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and cure; a document-wide search found no other suspension right, and §9 limits Vendor termination to material breach and insolvency (the only convenience right, §9.4, is Customer's).
- **§13.3 with §24.1** makes licence rights transferable to an Affiliate or successor, with Customer assignment to an M&A successor permitted without Vendor consent.
